Message:
[ALSA] hda-codec - Change Gigabyte K8N51 from 6stack to 6stack-digout

This patch moves the entry for the Gigabyte K8N51 from the 6stack
grouping to the 6stack-digout grouping, allowing for S/PDIF output
functionality.
